title: Reading a unary input prefix
statement: Let $C,d,n$ be natural numbers, and suppose the input is the string of $n$ ones. For every $j\le n$, starting at the initial reading label with all five registers zero and input position zero, the program returns to that label with the first register equal to $j$ and all others zero, input position $j$, and exactly $j$ ones appended. The run takes at most $3j$ steps, uniformly for every output string already printed.
hypotheses_covered: input equals the string of $n$ ones
initial register values are all zero
